user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate through the floating navigation menu links so that I can easily access different sections of the application. Acceptance Criteria: 
- When I click the 'Home' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
- When I click the 'News' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
- When I click the 'Contact' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
- When I click the 'About' link, I should remain on the same page and the URL should not change. 
- When I click the 'Elemental Selenium' link, I should navigate to 'http://elementalselenium.com/' and the URL should change accordingly.
